# RpaChallengeInputFormsProcess

**What it does.** One transaction per row of the input spreadsheet (xlsx, columns `First Name`, `Last Name`, `Company Name`, `Role in Company`, `Address`, `Email`, `Phone Number`). The process downloads the spreadsheet itself, in the first session. Sessions: “Preparação” → “Preenchimento por registro” → “Conclusão”.

Names in the code are in English. Page labels, spreadsheet headers, session names, text patterns, secret names and
rejection codes stay as they are: they are data and contracts (the mapping is in `manifest.json` → `naming`).

## How it is organized

| File | Content |
|---|---|
| `automation/pages.py` | one class per session: `PreparationPage`, `RecordFillingPage`, `ConclusionPage` |
| `automation/process.py` | `InputRow` (one spreadsheet row) and `RpaChallengeInputFormsProcess`: the order of the sessions |
| `automation/selectors.py` | `SelectorKey` (one key per element) and how each element is located |
| `main.py` | command line and the spreadsheet columns |
| `selectors.json` | the same targets, read by the nekkora_rpa runtime (generated from the same plan; never edit by hand) |
| `manifest.json` | revisions, hashes, `step_id` ↔ Studio step map, names and keys |

## Screens and what each method does

- **`PreparationPage`** — Screen of the session “Preparação” (runs once, before the spreadsheet rows): downloads the spreadsheet (“Download Excel cloud_download”) and clicks “Start”.
  - `download_spreadsheet()` — Clicks “Download Excel cloud_download” and saves the downloaded file in ``folder`` as ``challenge.xlsx``.
  - `click_start()` — Clicks “Start”.
- **`RecordFillingPage`** — Screen of the session “Preenchimento por registro” (runs once per spreadsheet row): fills “First Name”, “Last Name”, “Company Name”, “Role in Company”, “Address”, “Email” and “Phone Number” and clicks “Submit”.
  - `submit_record()` — Fills “First Name”, “Last Name”, “Company Name”, “Role in Company”, “Address”, “Email” and “Phone Number” with the values of one spreadsheet row and clicks “Submit”.
- **`ConclusionPage`** — Screen of the session “Conclusão” (runs once, after the spreadsheet rows): reads the text that matches the declared pattern.
  - `read_result()` — Reads the page text that matches the pattern declared in the generation config.

## How each element is located

| Key | Strategy | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| `SelectorKey.PREPARATION_DOWNLOAD_SPREADSHEET` | XPATH `//a[normalize-space(.)="Download Excel cloud_download"]` | relational XPath |
| `SelectorKey.PREPARATION_START` | XPATH `//button[normalize-space(.)="Start"]` | relational XPath |
| `SelectorKey.RECORD_FILLING_FIRST_NAME` | field labelled `First Name` | associated label |
| `SelectorKey.RECORD_FILLING_LAST_NAME` | field labelled `Last Name` | associated label |
| `SelectorKey.RECORD_FILLING_COMPANY_NAME` | field labelled `Company Name` | associated label |
| `SelectorKey.RECORD_FILLING_ROLE_IN_COMPANY` | field labelled `Role in Company` | associated label |
| `SelectorKey.RECORD_FILLING_ADDRESS` | field labelled `Address` | associated label |
| `SelectorKey.RECORD_FILLING_EMAIL` | field labelled `Email` | associated label |
| `SelectorKey.RECORD_FILLING_PHONE_NUMBER` | field labelled `Phone Number` | associated label |
| `SelectorKey.RECORD_FILLING_SUBMIT` | CSS `form input[type="submit"]` | stable container + attribute |

nekkora_rpa acts only if the locator finds EXACTLY one element with the expected identity; none, or more than one, is an error (it never picks the first one).

## Run

The Nekkora Studio prepares the environment of this automation: **Desenvolver automação → Pendências → Preparar ambiente** (Studio menu labels; its own venv, `nekkora-rpa[excel]==0.2.0`, dependencies checked by hash, confirmation before installing).

Outside the Studio (Python 3.12+, after publication on the approved index):

```sh
python -m venv .venv
.venv/Scripts/python -m pip install "nekkora-rpa[excel]==0.2.0"
.venv/Scripts/python main.py --output <folder> --console
```

Output: `resultados/` (one file per row), `execucao/` (JSONL events without values, checkpoint, summary) and `observacoes.json` (texts read from the page and the SHA-256 of the spreadsheet).
Generating code is not running it: run only in an authorized environment (benchmark).
